newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Hamilton, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Township of Hamilton
(County of Mercer)
New Jersey
General Obligation Bonds, Series 1997
Consisting of $12,500,000 of General Improvement Bonds
$7,000,000 of Sewer Utility Bonds
(Book-Entry-Only) (Callable)

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the undersigned for the Township of Hamilton, County of Mercer, New Jersey (Township''), at the Township Municipal Building, 2090 Greenwood Avenue, Hamilton, New Jersey, until 11:00 A.M., on
at which time they will be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of the following bonds (Bonds''), due on August 1, as follows:
General Improvement Bonds Sewer Utility Bonds
Year Principal AmountYear Principal Amount
The combined maturity schedule for the Bonds is as follows:
Year Principal Amount Year Principal Amount
The Bonds will be dated August 1, 1997 and bear interest
at the rate or rates per annum specified by the successful
bidder therefor, payable on August 1, 1998 and semiannually
thereafter on February 1 and August 1 in each year until
maturity or earlier redemption. The Bonds are subject to
redemption prior to maturity on the terms and conditions set
forth in the Preliminary Statement hereinafter mentioned.
Upon initial issuance, the Bonds will be issued in book-
entry-only form and registered in the name of Cede &Co., as
nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York
(DTC''). Individual purchases may be made in the principal
amount of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof through
book entries made on the books and records of DTC and its
participants. The Bonds will be issued subject to
approving legal opinion of Parker, McCay &Criscuolo,
Marlton, New Jersey, Bond Counsel.
Copies of the full Notice of Sale, Official Form of
Proposal and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained
by contacting the undersigned. The Township's telephone
Paul R. Kramer, Director of Finance
Dated: July 14, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
